gamerule.impendingdoom.minor_events_befo: Minor doom events before a major event
gamerule.impendingdoom:minor_events_befo: Minor doom events before a major event
omen.impendingdoom.faded: This omen of %s has faded. Fate has changed.
message.impendingdoom.omen_received: An omen of what comes next has been placed in your hands...
message.impendingdoom.raid_incoming: Illagers are marching on your homes!
message.impendingdoom.armor_warped: Your %s warps and will not stay on you!
message.impendingdoom.armor_unwearable: That armor is Warped and cannot be worn. Repair it or use a grindstone.
message.impendingdoom.blood_moon_sleep: You cannot sleep under the Blood Moon... unless you cover your eyes with wool.
message.impendingdoom.taunt.5: %s, your scent is so easy to follow.
message.impendingdoom.soul_thief_empower: A soul thief has drunk deeply and burns with stolen power!
message.impendingdoom.overheated: You overheat and tear off your heavy armor!
message.impendingdoom.kaiju: The ground trembles. Something enormous has risen.
message.impendingdoom.portal_rebuilt: A ruined portal has been rebuilt and lit by unseen hands...
event.impendingdoom.incoming_raid.desc: Illagers march on every player's respawn point. No village required: you are the target.
event.impendingdoom.monster_mutations.de: Monsters spawn bigger and stronger, with strange powers.
event.impendingdoom.tornado.desc: A tornado approaches and follows a player. Lead it away from your home.
event.impendingdoom.electrical_storm.des: Lightning charges any monster it strikes. Charged attacks stun.
event.impendingdoom.distortion.desc: Armor that wears down by a quarter becomes Warped and can no longer be worn.
event.impendingdoom.thieves.desc: At night, thieves come for your chests and flee to the caves with your loot.
event.impendingdoom.blood_moon.desc: Red nights, more monsters. Zombies dig, creepers explode when cut off. No sleep without wool over your eyes.
event.impendingdoom.hunted.desc: A pack of five named hunters is coming for each of you.
event.impendingdoom.famine.desc: Food feeds you half as much, crops will not grow and animals drop little meat.
event.impendingdoom.hordes.desc: Every night a horde marches on you, calling reinforcements as it fights.
event.impendingdoom.bloodlust.desc: A red haze falls upon every creature. When it lifts, the bloodlust remains.
event.impendingdoom.blackout.desc: Lights flicker and die. Relight them with flint and steel. The dark presses in.
event.impendingdoom.paranoia.desc: Fog. Footsteps. Something in the corner of your eye.
event.impendingdoom.wildfire.desc: Fire spreads faster and the grass itself burns.
event.impendingdoom.swarms.desc: Furious swarms of bees hunt in coordinated attacks.
event.impendingdoom.soul_thieves.desc: Possessed animals creep closer to drink your experience.
event.impendingdoom.summer.desc: Heavy armor overheats you by day. Stay hydrated.
event.impendingdoom.fall.desc: Leaves turn and fall. Piles of leaves breed creepers; tiny spiders and armed skeletons roam.
event.impendingdoom.winter.desc: Endless snow and blizzards. Crops die. Dress warmly or stay by the fire.
event.impendingdoom.spring.desc: Snow melts, crops flourish, and alpha animals stalk the fields.
event.impendingdoom.herobrine.desc: He watches from the fog. He was never removed.
event.impendingdoom.kaiju.desc: Every night a colossal monster rises and hunts you.
event.impendingdoom.unstable.desc: Earthquakes. Mining during a quake brings the ground down.
event.impendingdoom.meteor_shower.desc: End stone meteors fall from the sky, laden with ore.
event.impendingdoom.flooding.desc: The sea is rising. Rain makes it worse.
event.impendingdoom.volcanic_flooding.de: Lava rises through the caves below.
event.impendingdoom.solar_eclipse.desc: The sun goes dark. Monsters walk by day, wardens and creakings among them.
event.impendingdoom.nether_invasion.desc: The portals are open. The piglins are coming.
